threads.body: [General] Adding `QUERY` makes the public `setKnownMethods` Javadocs inaccurate: both overloads in `HttpClientAttributesExtractorBuilder`, `HttpServerAttributesExtractorBuilder`, `HttpSpanNameExtractorBuilder`, and `HttpServerRouteBuilder` still define the default set as RFC 9110 methods plus PATCH. That description implies `QUERY` is unrecognized by default. Please update those default-set descriptions to include `QUERY` as well.
